fairy.notes: Keep face, leafy hair and both fairy wings clear.

pixie.notes: Cropped tunic under the oversized head; leave rear wings visible.

goblin.notes: Chest below jaw; preserve belt buckle and ears.

imp.notes: Winged cat harness; keep horns, eyes and left wing unobstructed.

slime.notes: Low flexible girdle below mouth; no shoulders or face-crossing chest plate.

kitsune_1.notes: Small fox barding; preserve ears and large rear tail.

dryad.notes: Armor over leafy torso but keep leaf hair and twig branch distinct.

hellhound.notes: Fit below jaw and glowing flame collar; leave tail flame clear.

harpy.notes: Narrow breast plate; protect beak, extended wing feathers and talons.

unicorn.notes: Barding below muzzle; leave horn, lavender mane and tail visible.

pegasus.notes: High wing roots stay free; barding never paints the wings or mane.

griffin.notes: Lion-body barding behind beak and breast ruff; protect wings and tail.

basilisk.notes: Segmented belly band on upright coil; expose head, crest and rear coil.

cerberus.notes: Low harness spans one torso beneath all three heads.

wyvern.notes: Keep dorsal spines, tail stinger and both wings above the harness.

phoenix.notes: Breast plate follows upright bird body; expose head flame, tail feathers and feet.

thunderbird.notes: Leave lightning crest, face and wing markings uncovered.

sphinx.notes: Keep pharaoh headpiece, face, forepaws and curled tail clear.

yeti.notes: Chest sits under chin; preserve visible lower paw and face.

minotaur.notes: Fit torso under muzzle; preserve horns and belt medallion.

kitsune_9.notes: Very compact torso; nine-tail fan is completely protected.

dragon.notes: Under-jaw chest and side barding; protect wings, horn and tail.

kraken.notes: Low mantle girdle below the eyes; tentacles remain exposed.

hydra.notes: Low single-body harness beneath three necks; preserve every head.

fenrir.notes: Harness below white ruff; existing gold chains stay in front.

charybdis.notes: Lower-body cuirass keeps whirlpool mouth and side fins exposed.

leviathan.notes: Narrow belly plates on upright neck; keep fins, head and rear tail clear.

singularity.notes: Low flexible girdle; preserve face and entire galaxy swirl.

astraea.notes: Regalia below face; keep hair, crown stars and weaving-thread loops visible.

chronos.notes: Open right side for pocket watch; keep moon crown, long ears and tail clear.

aetherius.notes: Belly harness follows whale flank; star marks and flukes remain visible.

genesis.notes: Open center for divine chest gem; preserve flame crest, wing, tail and talons.

terminus.notes: Lower breast armor surrounds crescent emblem; large owl face stays clear.

paradox.notes: Fit sphinx torso; keep crown, split eyes, wings and tail unobstructed.

horizon.notes: Compact griffin breastplate behind head ruff and visible feathers.

karma.notes: Keep existing fate-thread gold loops and spool detail on top of armor.

zodiac.notes: Barding under white neck; protect antlers and flank constellation.

abyss.notes: Panther harness below jaw; leave raised tail and violet eyes clear.

nebula.notes: Articulated neck band; preserve horn, head, nebula fin and star markings.

supernova.notes: Under-mane barding; fire mane and tail flame stay visible.

nirvana.notes: Small koi body saddle behind face; preserve lotus crown and fins.

asgard.notes: Wolf harness under silver ruff; rainbow tail stays unobscured.

atlas.notes: Short plastron under neck only; preserve entire world-bearing shell and face.

prismite.notes: Little kitten harness; halo, eyes and floating tail remain distinct.

twine.notes: Keep clock gear and threaded back shell above fitted chest plate.

gloop.notes: Flexible low girdle avoids mouth, eyes and both gold stars.

barkley.notes: Keep golden eggshell helmet, leaf flank detail and curled tail visible.

centry.notes: Keep golden crest and existing shoulder medallion; add armor below it.

wisp.notes: Use open lower ring with center cutout for glowing heart; protect flame tip.

mudpup.notes: Soft broad harness under smile; preserve external gills and tail.

strix.notes: Small breastplate beneath circular owl mask; leave talons clear.

kelpie.notes: Barding below water-horse jaw; keep flowing mane and water tail uncovered.

manticore.notes: Keep lion face, bat wings and scorpion tail visibly separate from chest harness.

will_o_wisp.notes: Suspended lower ring follows spirit base; protect flame crown and wisp tail.

rukh.notes: Fit beneath head ruff; leave brown wings, beak and talons exposed.

glacius.notes: Under-neck harness preserves major ice shoulder crystal and tail shards.

behemoth.notes: Heavy low barding; expose mountain back spikes, face and short tail.

wendigo.notes: Keep antlers and skull face unarmored; narrow chest beneath white throat.

jormungandr.notes: Articulated lower coil harness; protect horns and face on upper coil.

simurgh.notes: Breast panels flank sacred gem; tail and turquoise wing remain exposed.

void_chronos.notes: Keep broken moon crown, backward pocket watch and ears visible.

fractured_genesis.notes: Breast panels around gem; multicolor fractured feathers are protected.

abyssal_nebula.notes: Low panther harness keeps violet eye pair and cosmic flank stars visible.

corrupted_leviathan.notes: Segmented neck plating below head; preserve violet fins and rear tail.

corrupted_fenrir.notes: Open face and gold chains; low torso armor remains beneath corrupted fur.

corrupted_dragon.notes: Keep wing membranes and corrupted chest fissure distinct; armor surrounds the fissure.

ancient_chronos.notes: Ancient watch, moon crown and long ears stay in front of armor.

ancient_genesis.notes: Protect ancient flame crown and chest gem; wing and talons stay clear.

ancient_abyss.notes: Low harness preserves face and golden crescent on forehead.

ouroboros.notes: Fit belly on lower coil; preserve head and visible luminous rune clusters.

ascended_slime.notes: Low flexible girdle keeps face, star sigil and hovering crown visible.

ascended_unicorn.notes: Preserve horn, gold mane trim and star marked flank.

ascended_pegasus.notes: Wing-root harness leaves wings, mane and golden hooves visible.

ascended_phoenix.notes: Chest panels around heart motif; preserve flame crest, tail fan and talons.

radiant_goblin.notes: Low chest fit avoids face and Sunforge belt emblem.

radiant_imp.notes: Leave gold horn, forehead star and wings clear of armor.

radiant_hydra.notes: Single harness beneath three necks; keep all three radiant head sigils visible.

radiant_kitsune.notes: Tiny torso barding; preserve full gold-tipped tail fan.

frost_sprite.notes: Suspended lower ring fits beneath face; ice crown and ears remain visible.

permafrost.notes: Short under-neck plastron; keep complete segmented ice shell and face visible.

abyssal_eel.notes: Narrow segmented mid-coil armor; protect head, dorsal fin and tail.

loom_fragment.notes: A lower frame mounting rather than a human cuirass; central face and Loom frame stay clear.

prismara.notes: Narrow serval torso; protect broken crown, crystal mantle, chest prism and three shard tails.

timestitch.notes: High small torso; preserve spool, chest watch, ribbon tail and long springing legs.

nebuloom.notes: Horizontal salamander side harness behind face; preserve crescent tail, dorsal stars and four flipper feet.

rootwarden.notes: Fit around existing golden eggshell breastplate; preserve antlers, wings, leaf marks and root paws.
